I am old now, 77 years, but this maize plot is what feeds my household. I have farmed here in Mulanje all my life. If I get the FISP coupon this year, I will use the NPK and urea on this small plot first because it is closest to the house and gives the best yield. I will also put some manure from my goats, and I try to use the hybrid seed when the coupon brings it. I cannot work like before, so my children and grandchildren help me, and sometimes I pay a young man for a few days to help with ridging and weeding.
